title: Glass Angel Mannequin
description: A glowing plasma lamp shaped like a stylized tree sits on a dark base with a visible plaque. Bright yellow electrical arcs branch upward through a clear glass sphere, connecting to pink and blue bulb-like tips, while a painted tree with blue orbs stands in the background casting a purple shadow across the surface.
prompt: Surreal still life painting of a vintage plasma globe lamp designed as a glowing angel mannequin tree. Bright yellow electrical tendrils branch inside a large clear glass sphere, connecting to pink and blue bulb tips and a central pink rose. A dark sculpted tree with blue spherical ornaments stands to the left against a gradient background. Dramatic purple shadows fall across the surface, in the style of Logan Sevin.
